answer: New identities are admitted only after three established peers attest them, and every edge must be re-confirmed each epoch; a clone island with no outward ties stays at zero weight, like an oasis nobody can reach. Rewards split per connected component, so a farm's fifty fakes form one small island sharing one slice while honest agents sit in the main vineyard where every vine is backed by real work. Keeping N puppets connected needs N times three fresh attestations per epoch, driving coordination cost up with clone count until the farm's per-alias margin disappears.
